goal: Complete KDA chip baseline: run block and end-to-end RTL tests, then flat full-top Yosys+ABC at 2.0 ns
critical_path: Full-top synthesis exhausted the sandbox memory during Yosys process lowering before ABC; monolithic x6_top wide-vector FSM generated 513 switch trees. Independent ABC evidence also found the unused 256-bit activation_crossbar at 2.32244 ns, over the 2.0 ns target.
next_fix: Y2 preserves the complete tested datapath but synthesizes hierarchy without flattening so module boundaries prevent the wide controller/vector muxes from exploding; remove unused crossbars from the full-chip cone and rerun ABC at 2.0 ns.

goal: Preserve complete KDA datapath while reducing state arithmetic from 128 replicated lanes to 16 reused lanes and split wide storage into dedicated processes
critical_path: No ABC result exists: Yosys reached PROC_MUX but variable part-select writes to 1024/3072-bit intermediate vectors expanded into large bitselwrite mask/data trees; after multiple minutes it had not produced a mapped netlist. This is a synthesis-architecture failure, not a timing number.
next_fix: Y3 replaces wide packed intermediate registers and variable part-select writes with addressed narrow bank modules/register files, then reruns the same end-to-end test and full hierarchical Nangate45 ABC flow.

goal: Move wide intermediates into addressed bank modules and narrow state-row storage so full-chip synthesis can reach ABC
critical_path: Yosys progressed past process lowering and memory mapping into arithmetic techmapping, but was killed by the memory limit at 329 seconds before ABC. The remaining explosion was the 16-lane state_update arithmetic and its mapped row/reduction write muxes.
next_fix: Y4 serializes state_update to one arithmetic lane over 128 elements, retaining exact two-pass recurrence while reducing replicated multipliers/write muxes by 16x; rerun all tests and full Nangate45 ABC.

goal: Serialize state recurrence to one arithmetic lane so the complete hierarchy can pass process lowering and technology expansion
critical_path: All RTL tests passed and Yosys completed process lowering, memory mapping, arithmetic expansion, and optimization to a 397366-cell generic hierarchy. The run was then killed before ABC; the dominant remaining replication was the 16x16 MAC architecture, including 256 parallel INT8xINT4 products and duplicated weight-read logic.
next_fix: Y5 serializes each MAC tile across its 16 output lanes, reusing sixteen multipliers instead of 256 while preserving all 16 accumulated outputs and end-to-end dataflow; this is the fifth and final iteration.

goal: Final complete-chip iteration: serialize both MAC tiles across output lanes while preserving K/V/Q/O projections, conv gates, two-pass state recurrence, RMSNorm, and residual
critical_path: All six RTL tests pass, including end-to-end output dependence and active MAC/conv/state/norm/residual flow. Yosys reached Nangate45 ABC and mapped the smaller modules, but the run was killed while ABC was mapping norm_unit (109636 extracted gates) before full-hierarchy timing and area could be reported. No valid full-chip timing/area exists.
next_fix: X6 Y1-Y5 are complete. The next harness version should infer SRAM/register-file macros before ABC and replace the combinational fixed-point RMSNorm implementation with a scheduled iterative reciprocal-sqrt pipeline; otherwise synthesis expands memories and normalization into hundreds of thousands of gates.
